basic_details.job_title: U.T. Administration of DNHDD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Chowkidar, Teacher and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Samagra Shiksha, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (U.T. Administration of DNHDD) has announced 10 vacancies for Full- Time Teacher: (UPS) Social Science (Marathi Medium) for KGBV Kherdi, Part Time Teacher: (TGT/PGT) Social Science / Science-Maths (Gujarati Medium) for KGBV Dapada, Part Time Teacher: Physical Education Teacher for KGBV Kherdi, Part Time Teacher: Art Teacher for KGBV Kherdi, Asst. Cook (KGBV Dapada), Chowkidar (KGBV Kherdi & Dapada), and Sweeper (KGBV Dapada) posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can submit their offline applications by post,

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Full- Time Teacher: (UPS) Social Science (Marathi Medium) for KGBV Kherdi
Part Time Teacher: (TGT/PGT) 1.Social Science 2.Science-Maths (Gujarati Medium) for KGBV Dapada
Part Time Teacher: 1.Physical Education Teacher for KGBV Kherdi
Part Time Teacher: 2. Art Teacher for KGBV Kherdi

qualification.details: Educational Qualifications: | Full-Time Teacher (Social Science - Marathi Medium): Graduation and 2 years Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% marks either in Graduation or in Post-Graduation and B.Ed.; OR Graduation with at least 45% marks and 1 year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed.) as per NCTE norms; OR Senior Secondary (Class XII pass) with at least 50% marks and 4 years Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); OR Graduation with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. (Special Education). Candidates must have passed CTET or TET conducted by Central or State Government and studied in Marathi medium at Secondary level. Part Time Teacher (TGT/PGT - Social Science / Science-Maths - Gujarati Medium): Post Graduate from recognized University in respective subject with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution; OR Post Graduate with at least 50% marks in respective subject and B.A.Ed / B.Sc.Ed from NCTE recognized institution. Medium of study in SSC should be Gujarati. Part Time Teacher (Physical Education Teacher): Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution; OR Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed) with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution. Part Time Teacher (Art Teacher): 12th pass with a minimum 2-years Diploma in Drawing/Painting/Fine Art; OR Bachelor's Degree in Fine Art/Drawing & Painting/Commercial Art/Applied Art from recognized institution. Desirable knowledge of Marathi. Asst. Cook: 4th std. passed and experience in Cooking. Chowkidar: 10th std. passed or has at least attempted SSC. Sweeper: 4th std. passed. | Age Limit and Relaxations: Age limit is not exceeding 30 years for posts 1 to 5. Upper age limit is relaxable as per orders/guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time.

selection_process: The engagement will be made through a Walk-in-Interview scheduled for 22 October 2026 starting at 10:00 am onwards at the Department of Education
Dadra & Nagar Haveli. Candidates shall appear along with all original documents/certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the nature of the engagement for these posts?
faq.answer: The positions of Full Time Teacher, Part Time Teachers, Asst. Cook, Chowkidar, and Sweeper are purely on a short-term contract (STC) basis under Samagra Shiksha.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: All the above-mentioned posts are only for female candidates, and preference will be given to local candidates. Specific educational qualifications and medium requirements apply to each post as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation applicable?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 30 years for posts 1 to 5, which is relaxable as per orders and guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable or specific knowledge requirements for certain posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for teaching posts must have studied in the concerned medium (Marathi or Gujarati) at the Secondary level. For the Art Teacher post, desirable knowledge of Marathi is specified.

faq.question: Q5. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA shall be admissible to candidates appearing for the Walk-in-Interview.
